params.body:
The approach page said that everything that can be handed over "goes to the school, its teachers and technicians, and the ministry". Handing over to a ministry is more than what happens: the handover is to the school and the people who run the system there.

## Change

- English: "goes to the school and to its teachers and technicians."
- Dutch: "gaat naar de school en naar haar leerkrachten en technici."
- French: "passe à l'école, à ses enseignants et à ses techniciens."

Not changed: the platform page, where "the ministry" means the official forms a school hands in, and the team page.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 29 passed. `npm run build` and `npm run check:built`: no contact number.
params.title: Approach page: the handover goes to the school and its people
